reviewed_high_value_regions.note: Broad and orthogonal recall converge on pre-existing cohort heterogeneity exposed by deleveraging and late-period small-bank market-discipline shocks. Wholesale funding and shadow-asset complexity are strategy/risk dimensions rather than a second period-wide rural-bank model; provincial-union support and recognition changes are cross-cutting mechanisms; village banks remain a smaller sponsor-led parallel lineage; internet/digital deposits are an emerging funding technique rather than a new lineage.

Broad recall surfaced materially novel funding-geography, sponsor/shareholder-control, depositor-confidence, provincial-support/resolution and forbearance-recognition leads. The independent orthogonal challenge was refinement-dominant and found no second period-wide BANK-RURAL structural category: funding geography is an overlay on legal lineage; village banks remain a distinct sponsor-led tail; RCC/RCB-derived institutions remain heterogeneous; provincial shared services and resolution capacity are cross-cutting mechanisms rather than pooled solvency. Exact cohort prevalence, province sequences and event mechanics remain Evidence-stage questions.

known_major_gaps: BANK-RURAL 1990-1994 through 2020-2022 are broad+orthogonal complete. TIME-2023-2026 is the final unopened primary slice.

The 2023-2026 broad challenge should recover persistent low-rate/NIM compression; deposit termization and pricing discipline; property and local-government spillover/resolution effects on county banks; post-pandemic asset-quality recognition; small-bank capital and high-risk-institution clean-up; provincial rural-credit reform, mergers and stronger legal-person integration without backdating later entities; rural revitalization/agriculture/micro-SME credit policy and profitability tensions; digital-channel and fraud/cyber/operational risks; village-bank sponsor/franchise evolution; and resilient affluent-county counterexamples.

The final slice must distinguish announced reform, legal establishment, predecessor merger, capital injection and operational integration dates; later Outcome may not be backfilled into earlier Judgment.
Exact histories, event dates, actors, balances, ratios, ownership structures, sponsorship/restructuring terms, depositor amounts and official classifications remain Evidence-stage questions.
Evidence remains deferred while BANK-RURAL is unsealed.
